documentation.llmsText:
Model: test/flux/text-to-image
POST /v1/model-tasks with {"model":"test/flux/text-to-image","input":{...}}.
X-Request-Id is required (1-128 letters, digits, _ or -; a UUID is recommended). The task ID equals the X-Request-Id.
Submission is idempotent: if the POST times out, the connection fails, or it returns 429 or 5xx, resend the byte-identical body with the same X-Request-Id. It returns the existing task and is never charged twice. A different body with the same ID returns 409 request_id_conflict.
Poll GET /v1/model-tasks/{id} every 5 seconds with a total deadline; queued and running are pending, and only status=completed includes output. Null or empty output can be successful. If it returns 404 task_not_found, the POST never arrived: resend it with the same X-Request-Id instead of polling.
Declared file URLs are authenticated downloads. Preserve the API authorization header when downloading files.
